haiku-low.q1: Only the most recent missed fire time runs. Older missed fire times are dropped, with no run row and no history entry.
haiku-low.q2: The new run is recorded with status skipped and is not executed. next_fire_at then moves to the first fire time after now.
haiku-low.q3: Up to 3 tries. The wait is 1 minute after the first failed attempt and 5 minutes after the second. After attempt 3 the run is marked failed.
haiku-low.q4: After its lease expires, 2 minutes without a heartbeat. The attempt was already counted at claim, so recovery does not count it again.
haiku-low.q5: The running job finishes normally. Queued runs are cancelled, and claims check status so none start. On resume, next_fire_at moves to the first fire time after now, with no catch-up.
haiku-low.q6: The unique key on (schedule_id, scheduled_for) makes the second insert hit the constraint and do nothing. SKIP LOCKED also lets only one worker take the schedule.
haiku-low.q7: In the next_fire_at column of job_schedule. It moves when the poll handles a due schedule, and on resume or re-enable.
haiku-low.q8: A claim locks a queued run with SKIP LOCKED. In one transaction it sets running, lease_owner, a new lease_token and lease expiry, adds 1 to attempt_count, and inserts an attempt row.
haiku-low.q9: In the run's lease_expires_at, renewed by heartbeats every 30 seconds. The reaper finds running runs whose lease_expires_at is in the past.
haiku-low.q10: In the run's not_before column, with status set to queued. The retry starts when a claim finds a queued run whose not_before has passed.
haiku-low.q11: A job_run row is recorded once per fire time, unique on (schedule_id, scheduled_for). A run_attempt row is recorded once per execution try.
haiku-low.q12: Each claim sets a new lease_token. The old worker's final write checks that lease_token still matches, so its stale write is refused and the newer outcome stands.

sonnet.q1: Only the most recent of the three missed fire times runs (one run created); the older two are dropped with no row or history. next_fire_at then moves to the first fire time after now.
sonnet.q2: A run for the new fire time is inserted with status skipped and is not executed, because another run of the schedule is still queued or running (waiting-for-retry counts as queued).
sonnet.q3: Up to 3 attempts. Wait is 1 minute after the first failure and 5 minutes after the second (via not_before). After the third failed attempt the run becomes failed.
sonnet.q4: After its lease expires, i.e. 2 minutes without a heartbeat (lease_expires_at in the past), the reaper requeues it (or fails it if attempt_count is already 3) following the step 4 rules (so retry wait/not_before applies). It does use up an attempt: the dead attempt was counted at claim, marked lost, and is not counted again.
sonnet.q5: The executing (running) job is not touched and finishes normally. The queued job is set to cancelled in the same transaction as the pause. On resume, next_fire_at is set to the first fire time after now, so fire times missed during the pause are not caught up.
sonnet.q6: The poll locks due schedules with SKIP LOCKED so only one worker handles the schedule; additionally the runs table is unique on (schedule_id, scheduled_for), so if the insert hits the unique key the other worker does nothing.
sonnet.q7: In the next_fire_at column of JOB_SCHEDULE. It is moved to the first fire time after now at the end of run creation (step 1), and reset to the first fire time after now when a tenant is resumed or a schedule is re-enabled.
sonnet.q8: The worker selects a queued run whose not_before has passed, locked with SKIP LOCKED, and in one transaction sets status running, lease_owner, a new lease_token, lease_expires_at = now + 2 minutes, adds 1 to attempt_count, and inserts an attempt row. It claims only if tenant is active and schedule enabled.
sonnet.q9: In the run's lease fields (lease_owner, lease_token, lease_expires_at), renewed by a heartbeat every 30 seconds to now + 2 minutes. The reaper, run by every worker on the poll, notices running runs whose lease_expires_at is in the past.
sonnet.q10: The run goes back to status queued with not_before set to now + 1 minute (after attempt 1) or now + 5 minutes (after attempt 2). The retry starts when a worker's claim poll finds the queued run with not_before passed and claims it.
sonnet.q11: Once per fire time: a run (JOB_RUN row, unique on schedule_id + scheduled_for). Once per execution try: an attempt (RUN_ATTEMPT row, unique on run_id + attempt_no).
sonnet.q12: Its write is refused because the final write applies only if lease_token still matches, and the token changed (new on every claim; the reaper also cleared the lease). The new worker's outcome stands.
